findings.current: Staring at the impossible landscape, I finally asked, “Where are we?”
findings.defect: The source says he feels as though he is surrounded by mysteries while looking at the scene. The current line keeps the landscape’s impossibility but drops that distinct image.
findings.rationale: The Korean explicitly describes the narrator’s feeling as being surrounded by the inexplicable; it is not only a description of the landscape.
findings.replacement: Feeling as though I were surrounded by mysteries, I stared at the scene before me and finally asked, “Where are we?”

summary: One minor omission: the narration drops the image of feeling surrounded by mysteries.
